title: Statue in Bronze of Afonso de Albuquerque
brief_description: Statue in Bronze of Alfonso de Albuquerque , Governor of Portuguese in India. (1510 A.D)
detailed_description: The statue is a representation of Alfonso de Albuquerque, the Governor of Portuguese India from 1510 A.D. It depicts him in a standing pose and features a notable characteristic - a long curly beard. The statue also shows Albuquerque wearing chain ornaments and holding a sword in his hand. Its dimensions are significant: it stands at a height of 3.10 meters and has a breadth of 1.20 meters.
